title: Use an Agent to SQL Query data inside your Spreadsheet with Business Central (Advanced Spreadsheets)

chapters.title: Introduction to AI Agent SQL Query Feature
Accessing the Agent via Facts Box
Creating SQL Joins with Agent Assistance

features.name: AI Agent SQL Query Generation
features.description: An AI agent that can automatically generate SQL statements to query data from Business Central tables and create joins between multiple tables like sales invoice header, customer, and ledger entries.
caveats: Agent can only be accessed through the facts box area on the right
Agent requires knowledge of table and field structures to work effectively

features.name: Advanced Spreadsheets with Agent Integration
features.description: The advanced spreadsheet and reporting app for Business Central integrates with an AI agent that can manipulate spreadsheet content and generate SQL regions to pull data from the database.
caveats: Manual SQL entry still requires understanding of SQL syntax
Yellow validation warnings may appear intermittently

features.name: SQL Region Creation in Spreadsheets
features.description: Users can manually create SQL regions within spreadsheets to define custom SQL queries that retrieve specific data from Business Central tables, such as selecting name from customer table.
caveats: Yellow validation warnings may appear while entering SQL
Requires basic SQL knowledge for manual query creation
